comment: Example spell/ability templates demonstrating balanced design

templates.name: Basic Attack
templates.description: Standard melee attack. No cost, always available. Baseline for comparison.
templates.designNotes: Cantrips should deal ~1d6 damage for single-target. This is the baseline all other abilities are measured against.

templates.name: Power Strike
templates.description: A powerful melee strike dealing extra damage.
templates.designNotes: Common abilities cost 10-20 resources and deal 2-3x cantrip damage. Avg damage: 11 vs cantrip's 3.5 = 3.1x multiplier.

templates.name: Fireball
templates.description: Classic AOE fire spell hitting multiple targets.
templates.designNotes: AOE abilities hit 3-5 targets for 60-70% per-target damage. Total potential: 3d6 × 3 = 31.5, single-target equivalent would be ~45 damage. Balanced by setup and miss risk.

templates.name: Healing Touch
templates.designNotes: Healing should cost 1.5x what damage costs (to prevent stalemate). Avg heal: 10. Equivalent damage ability would cost ~10. 15 = 10 × 1.5.

templates.name: Stun Strike
templates.description: Strike that stuns the enemy, preventing their next action.
templates.designNotes: Hard CC (stun) is worth ~10 budget per turn. Low damage (3.5 avg) + 1-turn stun (10 value) = 13.5 total value. Cost 45 is appropriate for major tier.

templates.name: Poison Dart
templates.description: Ranged attack that deals damage over time.
templates.designNotes: Total damage: 2.5 immediate + (2.5 × 4) = 12.5 damage. Direct damage ability would deal ~18 for same cost. DOT is 70% as efficient but bypasses some defenses.

templates.name: Shield Bash
templates.description: Bash with shield, dealing damage and pushing enemy away.
templates.designNotes: Minor CC (knockback) worth ~2-3 budget. Damage (avg 5.5) + knockback = decent value for 12 cost.

templates.name: Meteor Strike
templates.description: Massive AOE fire damage from above.
templates.designNotes: Ultimate ability. High cost + long cooldown. Avg 28 damage × 6 targets = 168 total potential. Single-target equivalent would be ~180-200 damage.

templates.name: Berserker Rage
templates.description: Enter a rage, doubling damage but taking more damage.
templates.designNotes: High-risk, high-reward. Extra damage over 3 turns (+100% = 3 extra attacks worth ~10 damage each = 30 value). Taking +50% damage is risky but balanced by offense.

templates.name: Stealth
templates.effect: Become invisible for 2 turns or until you attack
templates.description: Become invisible, avoiding detection and attacks.
templates.designNotes: Utility ability. Value is contextual (escape, positioning, surprise). Moderate cost for strong tactical value.

templates.name: Life Drain
templates.description: Dark magic that damages enemy and heals caster.
templates.designNotes: Damage (avg 14) + healing (avg 7) = 21 total value. Premium cost (50) for versatility and sustain.

templates.name: Chain Lightning
templates.damage: 5d6 to first target, 3d6 to second, 2d6 to third
templates.description: Lightning that jumps between enemies, dealing less to each subsequent target.
templates.designNotes: Creative AOE design. Total: 17.5 + 10.5 + 7 = 35 damage across 3 targets. Interesting mechanic with positioning strategy.

designPrinciples.aoeMultiplier: AOE abilities deal 60-70% damage per target compared to single-target
designPrinciples.dotEfficiency: Damage over time totals to 70-80% of equivalent direct damage
designPrinciples.healingCost: Healing costs 1.5x what equivalent damage costs
designPrinciples.ccValue: 1 turn of hard CC (stun) is worth ~10 power budget, soft CC worth ~5 budget
designPrinciples.riskReward: Risky abilities should have expected value equal to safe alternatives
